correctness.rationale: The inclusive graph-distance VR claim is fully reconstructed for GP(12,5), with edges i~i+1, i~12+i, 12+i~12+(i+5) mod 12, and thresholds 0,1,2,3,4. Fresh independent JavaScript enumerated 24 BFS distance rows, each with histogram [1,3,6,9,5]; K2 has exactly 24 vertices,108 edges,120 triangles,24 tetrahedra. Its two 12-vertex bipartition-induced subcomplexes independently satisfy 12/36/24 face counts, connectedness, two incidences per edge, connected six-cycle vertex links, compatible triangle orientations, and Euler characteristic 0, hence are both tori. The actual 108-step certificate was independently replayed as 96 genuine sequential elementary free-face pairs (24 triangle/tetrahedron, 60 edge/triangle,12 vertex/edge) plus 12 critical 2-face deletions, terminating exactly in the first torus. All 12 integral projected attaching-loop boundaries were reconstructed by subsequent elementary-collapse substitutions and matched independently computed integral boundaries of the supplied 2-chain arrays on that torus. Since torus π1=H1=Z², each attaching loop is nullhomotopic, giving K2 ≃ T²∨12S², not merely matching homology. At r=3 exact combinatorial reconstruction established K3=K2[A]*K2[B], all 5,328 faces of the join, hence K3≃4S³∨4S4∨S5 by suspension splitting. Independent mod-2 boundary ranks for K2 [0,23,83,24] give Betti [1,2,13,0]; K3 ranks [0,23,193,719,1149,575] give Betti [1,0,0,4,4,1]. Radius 1 is a connected 24-vertex 36-edge graph with 13 circles; radius >=4 is full simplex. Every radius-2 edge has an original 2-step path whose triangle induces H1(K1)→H1(K2) surjection, yielding exactly 11 [1,2) and 2 [1,3) H1 intervals and 13 [2,3) H2 intervals; K3 higher spheres yield [3,4) in dimensions 3,4,5, all over every field. Integral attaching and join proofs establish torsion-freeness; mod-2 ranks alone would not. Scope limited to this finite graph.

Parks–Marchette 2016 Theorem 5.3 imposes girth at least 10 for the cited persistence statement; not applicable to this girth-6 graph.
Adamaszek–Adams classify circle-metric Vietoris–Rips complexes, not the shortest-path word metric of this 24-vertex cubic graph.

value.rationale: This is a complete exact homotopy-and-persistence classification for the natural symmetric cubic Nauru/GP(12,5) graph, with a nontrivial torus stage plus twelve distinct nullhomotopic 2-cell attachments and a later join of two triangulated tori producing homology in degrees 3,4,5. The exact integral attaching boundaries and all-field interval multiplicities are mathematically informative invariants not implied by the graph’s famous genus-one embedding or known graph-square π1 fact. The four-scale transition and persistence behavior provide a reusable finite benchmark for graph-metric flag-complex theory. This is a motivated natural graph and invariant, not an arbitrary unmotivated graph slice; no assertion is made that a general family theorem, persistence-module cup products or equivariant classification follows.
